correctness.rationale: For every finite projective plane, the explicit simplicial subcomplexes U and V are contractible and meet in the incidence graph. The integral Mayer–Vietoris exact sequence identifies H_2 of their union with the integral graph cycle lattice. Swapping U and V reverses the connecting-map orientation and gives precisely the bipartition sign. The trace formula follows from the exact rational graph chain complex. The Fano verifier independently enumerates 331 Rips faces, 168 linear automorphisms, 168 dualities, signed simplicial Lefschetz traces, and integral fundamental cycles. It checks every trace, absolute irreducibility by sum of squared traces, polarity involution trace, and mod-two rank, with replay ending VERIFY_OK. Infinite-order generalization relies on the plane axioms, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Point-line dualities are genuine intrinsic symmetries of projective incidence data and interchange the two contractible halves in the established Rips description. Their sign action is lost under ordinary homotopy classification, so the full integral module is a motivated missing invariant. The result solves this for every finite projective plane, determines all symmetry characters, and in the smallest plane proves absolute irreducibility plus a nontrivially glued integral polarity lattice with three regular summands. This is not a known Betti-table recomputation or an arbitrary finite slice; q=2 is the first natural test case of a uniform theorem.
